title: Malaysia Plans First AI Law in 2027 as Scrutiny Intensifies
key_facts: Malaysia plans its first dedicated AI law in early 2027.
Digital Minister Gobind Singh Deo told parliament on Monday 5 Oct the government is drafting an AI Act with a 'risk-based approach'.
The government is also working on mechanisms to enforce rules on AI.
The EU has begun enforcing its AI Act.
Part of Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim's push on AI and social media risks; since June Malaysia requires platforms to bar under-16s from accounts and verify ages.
quote_evidence: MALAYSIA plans to introduce its first dedicated artificial intelligence law in early 2027
The government is drafting an AI Act that will take a "risk-based approach"
why_it_matters_hint: Another Asian government moves from guidance to binding AI rules.
notes: Bloomberg original blocked (403); Business Times copy carries the Bloomberg text in full.
